punchline: Meadows explains runaway loops with her own childhood: the more her brother pushed her, the more she pushed him back.
thirty_sec: Meadows says most systems run on two kinds of loop. A balancing loop pulls toward a goal, like hot coffee cooling to room temperature or a thermostat holding a room steady. A reinforcing loop feeds itself. Her brother pushes, she pushes back harder. She practices piano, enjoys it more, practices more. Money in the bank earns interest that earns interest. Her shortcut: divide 70 by the growth rate to get the doubling time.
